status_definitions.open: Not decided or not sufficiently tested.
status_definitions.supported_internal: Supported by analysis or experiments produced inside this repository.
status_definitions.mixed_internal: Internal evidence contains both support and material counterevidence.
status_definitions.contradicted_internal: Weakened or contradicted by evidence produced inside this repository.
status_definitions.supported_external: Supported by an identified independent replication.
status_definitions.falsified: A preregistered falsification condition was met.
status_definitions.decision: Governance or product decision; not an empirical finding.

replication_definitions.executable: Executable code exists but the result is not pinned by the quick reproduction protocol.
replication_definitions.independent: Reproduced by an independent party or implementation.

claims.statement: Edge-level historization plus revisit handling escapes the repository's designed cycle and trap domains more reliably than memoryless greedy.
claims.scope: Designed gridworld, domain-invariance, and falsification domains in this repository; not arbitrary graph navigation.
limitations: Domains and implementations were designed by the same project.
Memoryless greedy is intentionally weak on cycle traps.
No independent replication is recorded.

last_verified.result: Quick reproduction passed 8/8 claims; targeted baseline tests passed in the same run before sandbox-only tmp_path setup errors in unrelated persistence tests.

claims.statement: Historization is the dominant generally useful mechanism in E0 and should be the primary product surface.
claims.scope: Cross-mechanism product value, not merely success on designed trap domains.
limitations: The '6x confirmed' count has no six-item independent evidence mapping.
River City contains a stale-memory case where historization hurts.
No independent adoption or replication establishes general product value.
Mechanism dominance has not been measured by a complete causal ablation.

last_verified.result: Retained as a strategic hypothesis; removed as an unqualified fact.

claims.statement: In the reported C185 grid-city setup, the conservative overlay at confidence 0.85 improved completed trips by about 4.2% to 6% over E0 greedy, while confidence 0.5 was worse.
claims.scope: C185 5x4 traffic simulation with 10 and 20 vehicles and the report's fixed configuration.
limitations: The main 4.2%-6% result is tied to one synthetic topology family and fixed simulator design.
No committed machine-readable raw result artifact exists.
The experiment does not isolate phase from lookahead, path aggregation, or gating.
River City produces negative historization and overlay cases at other congestion levels.

last_verified.result: Report and executable inspected; result not promoted beyond its original scope.

claims.statement: The practical advantage attributed to the amplitude overlay is caused by phase interference rather than by lookahead, path aggregation, or confidence gating.
claims.scope: C185-style navigation and future G1 domains.

sources.role: overlay result without phase-free causal control
warning that typical tested regimes can remain constructive
preregistered measurement design; not executed evidence

limitations: No identical-horizon phase-free lookahead control is currently reported.
C319 indicates that cancellation may require wrapped or unstable phase regimes.
required_next_evidence: Execute the five-level causal ablation preregistered in docs/E0_G1_PROTOCOL_v1.json without reading or tuning on holdout results.
Store per-seed machine-readable results and confidence intervals.

claims.statement: In the constructed C319 examples, typical weights produce mostly constructive phase aggregation; outright cancellation appears only after the measured phase gap enters a wrapped regime.
claims.scope: Fields and weight sweeps implemented in lean/structural_geometry; not a representative survey of operational domains.
limitations: The examples are constructed, not sampled from a preregistered domain population.
The result weakens broad cancellation language but does not prove cancellation is absent in all useful domains.

last_verified.result: Acceptance suite included in targeted run.

claims.statement: The historization/revisit controller has executable synthetic scaling benchmarks through approximately 225 to 500 nodes.
claims.scope: Greedy controller with historization and revisit handling; not the amplitude/path-family layer.

sources.role: quick protocol pins the approximately 225-node wall grid

limitations: The quick protocol verifies approximately 225 nodes, despite older wording mentioning N=500.
The full benchmark is synthetic and does not exercise amplitude path enumeration.
No independent implementation or external workload is recorded.

claims.statement: The practical value and runtime behavior of the amplitude/path-family layer remain unverified at N >= 100.
claims.scope: Amplitude overlay and structural geometry, with value measured against equal-budget simpler controls.

sources.role: existing scaling benchmark explicitly covers historization/revisit controller, not amplitude
preregistered N=100/500/1000 measurement design; not executed evidence

limitations: The prior phrase 'no scaling beyond N approximately 50' incorrectly conflated the full framework with the geometry layer.
Asymptotic implementation complexity alone does not establish practical value or failure.
required_next_evidence: Execute the equal-budget G1 runs at N=100, 500, and 1000 preregistered in docs/E0_G1_PROTOCOL_v1.json.
Separate wall time, expanded paths, memory, goal rate, steps, and regret.
Five-level causal ablation from the evidence policy.

last_verified.result: Confirmed as a geometry-specific evidence gap, not a framework-wide absence.

claims.statement: The repository already contains in-house implementations of A*, BFS, tabular Q-learning, epsilon-greedy, random, and memoryless-greedy baselines.
claims.scope: Existence and executability of baseline code, not fairness or external validity.
limitations: These are project-owned implementations, not independent reference packages.
The SOTA comparison uses small custom domains of 4-22 nodes.
Existing hyperparameters and budget parity require a fresh G1 audit.

claims.statement: The C184b adapter navigates a graph derived from BPI 2017, but the report attributes the successful choice primarily to the Delta mapping rather than to interference.
claims.scope: The repository's filtered 24-activity process graph and hand-defined navigation objective; not held-out case-level prediction accuracy.
limitations: The adapter uses outcome knowledge in Delta/R0 construction.
This is not held-out case-level prediction or recommendation accuracy.
External data does not make the project-owned analysis an independent replication.

last_verified.result: Existing C184b work must be audited and extended, not described as absent.

claims.statement: No independent reproduction of the central E0 performance claims is recorded in the repository.
claims.scope: Independent party or independently maintained implementation; external datasets and project-owned standard baselines do not qualify.
limitations: Repository inventory cannot prove that no unrecorded external use exists.
Traffic or clone counts would show interest, not scientific replication.
required_next_evidence: Named independent reproducer and immutable commit/tag.
Machine-readable result bundle and environment manifest.
Disclosure of deviations from the original protocol.

last_verified.result: No independent reproduction artifact identified during WP-0 inventory.

claims.statement: The current quick reproduction command executes eight internally defined claims successfully at commit 87ff88d.
claims.scope: The predicates encoded in reproduce.py; not all repository claims and not independent replication.
limitations: Predicates are broad pass/fail checks and do not emit confidence intervals.
Several claims share domains and implementation components.
The command currently prints results but does not persist an immutable result bundle.

claims.statement: The lean packages are the current product candidates; the full framework remains the research carrier until Gate G1.
limitations: This is a reversible management decision, not proof of market value.
A separate product repository is deferred until evidence reconciliation and Gate G1.

decision_review.trigger: Gate G1 or material external adoption evidence
decision_review.current_action: Keep one research repository; package in place before any history-preserving split.

last_verified.result: Recorded explicitly as a governance decision.
